semantic.justification: Original ICU78.3 handleNext state transitions, unconditional/lookahead acceptance order, dictionary-character count, status/position/end mutations and forced-progress fallback are represented over actual prepared fields. Native compiled LibreOffice word/line rules and custom lookahead/16-bit-table witnesses match 2,450 forward states. Consumed UText native-index/next32 and complete ucstrTextAccess preserve deferred 32-unit chunks, codepoint alignment, lone surrogates and explicit/NUL lengths; 1,220 native states match. Native test access changes private visibility only, without replacing headers/methods/providers. Original RuleBasedBreakIterator/RBBIDataWrapper construction, public caches/dictionaries/word/title/UNO bootstrap and native allocator/ABI remain unverified; no fake iterator factory is exported. Original handleSafePrevious consumes the actual reverse table/trie, normalizes the source position and returns a safe restart point while retaining iterator position/status/end/dictionary fields. Native original method comparison covers 2,450 reverse states in addition to the retained 2,450 forward states. Added original utext_previous32, utext_current32, utext_getPreviousNativeIndex, utext_nativeLength and ucstrTextLength, preserving provider transitions, transient/restored cursor operations, lone surrogates and deferred length. All 1,220 native UText sequences retain earlier forward assertions and now compare full current/backward/length mutations. Public iterator/cache/dictionary/word/title/service construction and native allocator/ABI remain incomplete; a raw safe point is not exposed as a public word boundary.
